stories.title: 'Oh my gosh, here we go': How LeBron landed in Philadelphia
stories.summary: For 22-time All-Star LeBron James, his last decision was about loyalty -- not to any of his previous stops but to his own basketball compass.

stories.title: Bengals' Stewart carted off with left leg injury
stories.summary: Bengals defensive end Shemar Stewart was carted off the field Wednesday with a left leg injury suffered during the first day of training camp.

stories.title: Tigers fans salute Skubal after 1,000th strikeout
stories.summary: Tarik Skubal, in what could be his final start for the Tigers, was given a standing ovation after his 1,000th career strikeout during Wednesday's game vs, the Orioles.

stories.title: Star RBs Robinson, Gibbs appear to be hold-ins
stories.summary: Running backs Bijan Robinson and Jahmyr Gibbs appear to be hold-ins as they seek new contracts.

stories.title: NCAA suspends Tennessee LB over $427 flight
stories.summary: The NCAA has suspended Tennessee linebacker Arion Carter for the first two games of the season for accepting a $427 flight from an agent after he declared for the NFL draft.
